why_this_file: [R-GAP-01] review of 01-Sep-2026. The 30-Aug-2026 edition registered 1Q2026 REVENUE, GROSS PROFIT, NET PROFIT, BACKLOG and NEW SALES from the 1Q2026 earnings release, but never registered the 1Q2026 BALANCE SHEET, although the reviewed statements carrying it sit on the same result-centre page the release was taken from. The bridge therefore stands on 31-Dec-2025 while a 31-Mar-2026 balance sheet was available. That is the AMOC defect in miniature — a filing on the company's own archive that was not opened. The figures are recorded here as evidence; the delivered valuation is NOT retro-edited.
